Built with patented sole technology, the reebok ZigFuel maximizes energy return to the feet, offering a soft and springy ride: a complete energy drink for your feet that makes your key leg muscles so that you can do more. Equipped with a padded tongue, collar and soft inner lining, the Reebok ZigFuel provides an absolutely snug and comfortable Fit. Energetic from kick-off Light and energetic from the word Go, the Reebok ZigFuel reduces impact on the heel, which is especially beneficial for midfoot to heelstrike runners who land on their heels first. The Zig technology, coupled with the DMX Shear cushioning panels reduces impact and evenly distributes shock, returning maximum energy to the feet. description: FIRM Fit FOR SMOOTH RIDES  The  asics Gel Pulse 2 doesn't feature is a lot of fancy padding and exotic  material like its predecessor the Gel Nimbus 12. But what it does have  is absolute balance. With a   cushioning that is firm enough to protect  the legs during long runs, but equally soft for a comfortable ride, the  just about 12 oz heavy asics Gel Pulse 2 is a highly recommended  everyday trainer for runners with normal to high arches.  With  a not so ideal mushy cushioning, the forefoot of the Asics Gel Pulse 2  is designed to feel a little stiffer compared to other running shoes .  This is a deliberate feature to speed up the forefoot's transition from  mid-distance to toe-off. The SpEVA midsole of this shoe seems just  perfect and offsets the Asics Gel Pulse 2's lack of a Gel cushioned  forefoot.  Firm and responsive run   To  add to this excellent transition are the flex grooves in the outsole  that make for superb heel to toe transition, what with the Asics Gel  Pulse 2 not having a very wide toe box. Engineered with this improved  forefoot feel, the Asics Gel Pulse 2 is tuned towards a firm and  responsive run.  Pulsing with protection and comfort   Constructed  with a lightweight, breathable mesh upper, the Asics Gel Pulse 2  running shoe ensures it offers ample ventilation to the feet, keeping  them dry, fresh and free of sweat. Engineered with a rearfoot Gel  cushioning system, the heel is well locked in place and is protected  from impact, allowing for a smooth mid-distance transition. The insole  is also built with a Comforter Sockliner that not only provides ample  cushioning, enhancing performance, but also employs anti-microbial  properties, creating a cooler, drier and healthier environment inside  the shoe.  The  SpEVA midsole material improves the bounce back characteristics of the  Asics Gel Pulse 2 running shoe, decreasing midsole breakdown, while the  Trusstic System employed in the outsole enhances traction. This plastic  shank connecting the forefoot and heel of the outsole doesn't touch the  ground. It instead curves around the medial side of the foot, arching  neatly and locking the foot in place. description: shoes THAT MAKE YOU WANT TO RUN Highly recommended for moderate overpronators, the adidas Supernova Sequence 3 range of shoes are great looking stability running shoes . This updated version of the Supernova Sequence of adidas may not be very fancy, but it comes with a more flexible upper and outsole, which enhances gait and stability when on the run. Better flexing for better transition With a lot of arch support, the Adidas Supernova Sequence 3 has a redesigned forefoot with AdiPRENE technology and different flex points for better transition, which is especially helpful for overpronators. Pronation of the foot means its rotation movement and the way the body distributes weight during movement. In neutral pronators, the weight of the body and shock created during impact with the surface on movement are evenly distributed along the feet, protecting the legs from injuries. However, in overpronators, the lateral (outside) part of the heel strikes the ground first. When such individuals transfer weight from the heel to the metatarsal region, the feet end up rolling too far to the medial on inside arch of the foot, forcing the knees to buckle slightly inwards. This results in uneven distribution of shock and the ankles roll inwards, which could lead to serious leg injuries. In fact, if you study the shoes of overpronators, you will find that the inside arch area of the shoe towards the toe region wears away faster than the rest of the outsole. Hence, it is of prime importance that overpronators choose shoes that have excellent snug Fit and insoles and arches made of strong, durable material. The Adidas Supernova Sequence 3 range of shoes are replete with such an inside support area to support the weight when the runner lands on the lateral side of the foot and then rolls inwards. It has a strong impact guidance system which ensures that the weight is equally distributed along the strong points of the foot, and protects it from injuries. Stable and agile Considered as one of the best Stability running Shoes from the house of Adidas, the Supernova Sequence 3 has updated and improved flex in the upper and outsole. The forefoot region has been redesigned with AdiPRENE technology, a cushioning material added to the heel that absorbs impact and provides superior cushioning and protection. There are also improvements made in the various flexpoints to enhance easy movement and better transition of the feet. The stitched micro-suede upper of the shoe ensures a smooth forefoot fit that further enhances the natural movement and curving of the foot. The Adidas Supernova Sequence 3 range of shoes is engineered with memory foam heel and padded tongue, along with non-slip lining to lock the ankle in place and prevent it from slipping and getting blistered. These shoes are fitted with anti-microbial sockliners to keep the feet dry and healthy, allowing you to concentrate on your run rather than worry about sweaty, uncomfortable feet. With a Pro Moderator medial support device fitted into the shoe, the midsole of the Adidas Supernova Sequence 3 shoe is built with a Torsion system that supports the midfoot, without forcing the rearfoot to move excessively. With such lightweight arch support coming in a great package, the Adidas Supernova Sequence 3 shoes are highly recommended for moderate overpronators with normal arches for that ultimate stability during long runs.
